title: Replication package: the impact of key-hierarchy architecture on post-quantum migration costs in client-controlled encrypted storage

creators.name: Rodríguez-Aragón, Jesús F.
creators.affiliation: University of Salamanca; Universidad Internacional de La Rioja

description: Reference implementations (C/OpenSSL, Java/Bouncy Castle, JavaScript/WebCrypto and @noble/post-quantum) of four key-hierarchy architectures for client-controlled encrypted storage, the measurement harnesses, the raw measurements of the pre-registered campaign (OSF registration f6ugk) and the analysis scripts.
